title: US drug overdose deaths per year (thousands)

source.name: Drug Overdose Deaths in the United States
source.publisher: U.S. CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: 1999: 16,849 drug overdose deaths, the NCHS baseline year commonly used in trend analyses (NCHS Data Brief 428). 2022: 107,941 deaths, the historical peak (NCHS Data Brief 491 / CDC reporting). 2024: 79,384 deaths, the most recent final data available (NCHS Data Brief 549), down from the 2022 peak but still nearly 5x the 1999 level.
